svg.text: EN tied to VIN on the board
VBAT after the switch, to the battery sense divider
Battery sense: GPIO1 reads half the cell voltage (1.5 to 2.1 V)
3.5 mm jack: RA, LA, RL electrodes
A dot joins wires; wires that cross without a dot are not connected.
Checked by scripts/check_vest_circuit.py against the datasheets.
